Reading: Culture & Employer Brand

Read the text

Company culture includes values, behaviors, and work environment. Mission explains the company's purpose. Vision describes future goals. Employer brand is how companies attract talent. Engagement measures if employees enjoy work. Strong culture improves retention. Companies with positive culture attract better talent. Culture is communicated through stories and rituals. Values are demonstrated through leadership actions.
